notes: Authoritative record spec for the Khajiit pilot. Feeds the Mutagen authoring run (record creation) plus CKRA promoted ops (formlist.add + vmad.attach_script wiring). slots.playerFacingText: The moons keep you hardy. Your resistance to disease rises by 5%.

slots.rehomedFrom: existing manager T1 reward record (CAT-6 pilot)
slots.playerFacingText: The moons have noticed how you move. At night, your stamina regenerates 5% faster and your resistance to disease rises by 10%.
You are deeply attuned to the Lunar Lattice. At night your stamina and magicka regenerate faster and disease finds little purchase.

neglect.playerFacingText: You have not kept the moons. At night your stamina regenerates 5% more slowly until you return to the road and the lattice.

emphasisRewards.playerFacingText: The open road is kinder to you. Stamina regenerates 4% faster.
The road-walker bears more and tires less. Stamina regenerates 7% faster and you carry 30 more.
Khenarthi's wind is at your back. Stamina +10%, carry +50, and you move a little faster.
Twilight feeds the mind. Magicka regenerates 4% faster.
The twilight wards you. Magicka regenerates 7% faster and magic resistance rises 5%.
You see by the twilight Azurah keeps. Magicka +10% and magic resistance +10%.
The outsider endures. Your armor rating rises by 5.
The survivor mends quickly. Armor +10 and health regenerates 10% faster.
Baan Dar's luck is with you when the odds are not. Armor +15, health regenerates 15% faster, and your claws strike harder (+10 unarmed).
You move as the Purring Liar taught. Sneak +5.
Shadow and lock yield to you. Sneak +8 and Lockpicking +10.
The legend works through your hands. Sneak +12, Lockpicking +15, Pickpocket +15, and clawed strikes +10 unarmed.
The Dragon King's order steadies you. Fire resistance +5%.
You keep the line against chaos. Fire resistance +8% and magic resistance +5%.
Alkosh's roar is in your blood. Fire resistance +12% and magic resistance +15%.

v1RecognitionSurface: Champion Survey/status text only (non-voiced). Voiced NPC recognition lines are V2 per PDV_RecognitionDialogueScalePacket.md.
budget: Two always-on families: lunar substrate boons (Layer 1, broad lunar) + one focused emphasis set (Layer 2). At the PDV_RaceRewardBudgetLedger two-family cap.
